name: ichtus-leuven
description: Bilingual Payload website for Ichtus Leuven

scripts.check: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_SECRET=local-check-payload-secret-with-32-characters NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://check.ichtus.test sh -c 'biome check . && tsc --noEmit && vitest run --config ./vitest.config.mts'
scripts.deploy:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production PAYLOAD_DB_PUSH=false CLOUDFLARE_REMOTE=true CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production sh -c 'tsx src/scripts/preflight.ts --env=production && payload migrate && wrangler d1 execute D1 --command "PRAGMA optimize" --env=production --remote && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env=production && tsx src/scripts/syncRuntimeConfig.ts && tsx src/scripts/deployScheduler.ts'
scripts.deploy:staging: cross-env NODE_ENV=production PAYLOAD_DB_PUSH=false CLOUDFLARE_REMOTE=true CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging sh -c 'tsx src/scripts/preflight.ts --env=staging && payload migrate && wrangler d1 execute D1 --command "PRAGMA optimize" --env=staging --remote && opennextjs-cloudflare build --env=staging && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy --env=staging && tsx src/scripts/syncRuntimeConfig.ts && tsx src/scripts/deployScheduler.ts'
scripts.seed:prod: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_DB_PUSH=false CLOUDFLARE_REMOTE=true CLOUDFLARE_ENV=production tsx src/scripts/seed.ts
scripts.seed:staging: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--no-deprecation PAYLOAD_DB_PUSH=false CLOUDFLARE_REMOTE=true CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging tsx src/scripts/seed.ts

PAYLOAD_SECRET.description: Generate a random string using `openssl rand -hex 32`
